const b = $json.body ?? $json;
return [{ json: { source: b.source ?? 'unknown', message_id: b.message_id ?? null, sender_name: b.sender_name ?? b.sender ?? null, sender_email: b.sender_email ?? null, subject: b.subject ?? null, received_at: b.received_at ?? new Date().toISOString(), body: b.body ?? b.text ?? '' } }];
